name: orvia-ai-surveillance
description: Local-first AI video analytics demonstration for food-safety operations.

scripts.edge: cd services/edge && DATA_DIR=data/client-demo uv run uvicorn foodsafe_edge.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.edge:prior-data: cd services/edge && DATA_DIR=data/live uv run uvicorn foodsafe_edge.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.edge:fallback: cd services/edge && DATA_DIR=data/client-fallback CAMERA_KIND=file CAMERA_SOURCE=assets/fallback-demo.mp4 CAMERA_LABEL='Prerecorded local fallback' DETECTOR_BACKEND=hog uv run uvicorn foodsafe_edge.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.markers: cd services/edge && uv run python scripts/generate_markers.py
scripts.camera:soak: cd services/edge && uv run python scripts/pipeline_soak.py --minutes 10
scripts.camera:raw-soak: cd services/edge && uv run python scripts/camera_soak.py --minutes 10
scripts.ppe:acceptance: cd services/edge && uv run python scripts/ppe_acceptance.py
scripts.demo:rehearse: cd services/edge && uv run python scripts/rehearse_demo.py --minutes 8
